name: EYONIS-AIDS-DS/CADe-CADx-evaluation
description: This repository provides a complete evaluation of the performance of CADe (Computer-Aided Detection) and CADx (Computer-Aided Diagnosis) systems. It computes ROCs, Precison-Recall, FROCs (with severall Operating Points spacifictions), bootstrapps, Confidence Intervals, statistical comparison tests, across sets of detection predictions (...)
